_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. namespace = what <Namespace> becomes; placeholders = the skill's other placeholders (routePrefix must not collide with another example's route on the shared Clean host); assets = every file the skill ships, since the single approach uses all of them. No host = clean: this approach is C# that registers into DI, and Clean supplies the published content it reads. No requires block: the fixture only needs a published root, which Clean always installs.
